SELECT p.id AS pet_id, p.name AS pet_name, p.type AS pet_type, p.breed AS pet_breed, p.age AS pet_age, p.weight AS pet_weight, p.image_url AS pet_image_url, p.owner_id AS pet_owner_id, p.created_at AS pet_created_at,

o.id AS owner_id, o.name AS owner_name, o.phone AS owner_phone, o.email AS owner_email, o.address AS owner_address, o.created_at AS owner_created_at FROM pets p INNER JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id
